spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: On the Cycle of Knowledges and the Ordering of the Ruling Love

---

**¶1:** The revolving system of spiritual knowledges, which is disclosed to your understanding, is a great and powerful reality. It is one among four fundamental orderings of the spiritual world; for the entire ruling love is distributed into four domains of governance.

**¶2:** The first domain comprises the active forces that operate within the ten interior degrees of heaven existing above the natural mind, and the ruling love that is held fast within them — restrained and enclosed within those higher states of wisdom that are above.

**¶3:** The second domain comprises the eight natural and sub-natural degrees that lie below: the four that are mixed states of good and evil, and the four regions of pure falsity. This second domain extends from the conscious natural mind, upon which the human understanding walks, downward into the depths beneath.

**¶4:** The third domain comprises the protective boundaries of doctrine and the containing forms that encompass the whole interior life. These are the four elevated states of love and the three doctrinal vessels, together with all that they hold within them, and the ruling love that is enclosed within these structures, and the active forces that exercise dominion over them.

**¶5:** The fourth domain is the revolving system of spiritual knowledges, which is appointed with great providential care, as it is ordered in a [GAP-1] manifold [GAP-2] arrangement; that which proceeds from the Divine Wisdom as the origin of spiritual life, [GAP-3: REVIEW — and that which proceeds from the Divine Love as the generative source of] all living affections.

**¶6:** Its [GAP-4] constitution is [GAP-5] arranged with providential care, on account of the great and fierce evils, and the enormous forms of the selfhood, [GAP-6: REVIEW — which are held dependent] upon it, being suspended from this system. Thus all the primary and governing forces from among the rulers of every evil — those which had existed throughout the three domains — were gathered in. They were collected together, seized, restrained, and assigned upon this revolving order. Each was apportioned out of these three domains. They were distributed, intertwined in mutual opposition, and counterbalanced against their adversaries of equal force.

**¶7:** Yet the revolving system of knowledges is itself equal to them in its power — equal to the forces of enmity that are restrained upon it. Indeed, they were suspended upon the turning cycle on account of their destructive nature, so that, by reason of the spiritual influx and the perpetual motion in which they circulate, they cannot comprehend the state in which they are placed. For if they had been restrained in the higher states of heaven, those heavenly degrees would not have possessed the strength to sustain them. Again, if they had been assigned upon the natural states — upon the fixed foundations that are below — those also would not have possessed the strength to sustain them. Rather, they were suspended upon the revolving cycle of spiritual knowledges, so that the power and the wisdom that ascend from the natural degree below can be received and transmitted to the celestial states above them. Conversely, whatever descends from above — whether the absence of love or the fire of love — the revolving system also receives it and distributes it upon every natural state, upon all perception.

**¶8:** Behold, the ordinance of this revolving system is of this nature. For the evil forces that are intertwined upon the cycle are governed in this way: as a ruling principle masters its entire domain by means of a mighty organized force drawn from all the governing powers of that domain; and by means of all the truths arrayed for spiritual combat that are collected together for it; and also by means of the mass of spiritual goods belonging to that domain; and by the alluring and enticing quality of the affections that are gathered about it; together with [GAP-7] the goods [GAP-8] and those natural affections [GAP-9] that have been distributed among its subordinate powers. Yet if you inquire about that ruling principle, it is perfectly matched against all its subordinate forces. Its retinue, for its part, is counterbalanced against the entire domain. Judgment proceeds from it — vindication and condemnation — throughout its entire dominion: by its understanding of truth, its application of truth, and its power of good.

**¶9:** Now, just as this ruling principle is matched against the measure of its entire dominion by its understanding, its application, and its power, so also is it with the forces of evil that are restrained upon the revolving system when compared to the ruling love and the active powers that exist throughout the whole spiritual territory. As the ruling principle stands toward its subordinate forces, so also is this totality gathered into the revolving system — into seven governing states, into twelve fundamental progressions of the spiritual life. As all doctrinal systems are gathered under the ruling principle, so again they are gathered under the governing states of the whole interior life. All that is accomplished in the spiritual world above and below — the combats and the disorders and the bondage to evil and the hunger for truth and the desire of self-love and the possession of goods — all these increase and diminish through these governing states. They are the movers of the entire created order, the totality being gathered into them in the way that I have disclosed to you. I have opened your interior sight.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The wheel of the stars, which is displayed to you, is a great mighty thing! Also, it is one among the four great things; since the whole ruling-power is assigned to four parts.
The first part is the powers who occur in the ten firmaments that exist above the wheel, and the ruling-power that is bound in them, as it is imprisoned within them in the heavens that are above.

The second part is the eight earths that are below; the four that are composite, and the four places of darkness. The second part extends from this earth, upon which mankind walks, towards the underside.

The third part is the walls and the vessels that surround the worlds. They are the four mountains and the three vessels; with what is in them, and the ruling-power that is trapped within them, and the powers who are masters over them.
The fourth part is the sphere of the stars that is appointed with great diligence, as it is ordered in a [great m]any [ways]; that of the Father of Life, [and that of the Mother of] the living.

Its [ordering is] very [carefully arranged] with diligence, because of the great and cruel powers, and the titanic figures, [who are bound] in it; they being suspended from it. So, all the first-born and the leaders of all the rulers, they who were existing in the three parts, these were garnered. They were collected together, seized, bound and assigned on this wheel. Each was apportioned by these three parts. They were distributed, entwined, and weighted against their companions of the same size.

Still, for its part, the wheel is equal to them in its strength; the powers of the enmity who are bound on it. Indeed, they were suspended on the circling wheel because of their cruelty; so that, due to the wind and the motion in which they go round, they comprehend not the place wherein they are set. For if they had been bound in the heavens, the heavens would not have had the strength to support them. Again, if they had been assigned on the earths, on the fixtures that are below, they also would not have had the strength to support them. Rather, they were suspended from the wheel of the circling stars; so that the power and the light that should come up from below can be received, and given to the heavenly ones above them. Conversely, whatever will fall from above, whether cold or hot, the wheel of the sphere will also take it and cast it out upon the entire earth, upon all the wood.

Behold, the ordinance of the wheel is in this form. For the powers who are entwined on the wheel are like this: a king mastering his kingdom by this mighty legionary force of all the leaders of the kingdom; and with all the armour of the soldiery that is collected together for him; and also with the mass of the property of the kingdom; and the beautiful lustful aspect of the women who are collected together for him; together with [all the] property [and goods] and those cattle [and flocks] that have been distributed about among his retinue. Yet, if you ask about that king, he is matched with all his retinue. His retinue, for its part, is matched against his entire kingdom. Judgement shall come forth from him, vindication and condemnation, to his entire kingdom; by his wisdom, skill and strength.

Now, just as for this king, who is matched against the measure of his entire kingdom by his wisdom, skill and strength; so also is it for the powers who are bound on the sphere as compared to the ruling-power, and the powers who exist in the entire zone. Like the king towards his retinue; so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere, to seven leaders, to twelve signs of the zodiac. As all the cities are gathered to the king, again they gather to the leaders of the universe. All that is done in the universe above and below: the battles and the disorders and the captivity and the hunger and the lust and the property; so shall they increase and diminish through these leaders. They are the motivaters of the whole created order; the totality being gathered in to them the way that I have told you. I have opened your eyes!

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading indicates "manifold" at this position; "great many" is the natural-plane Kephalaia equivalent, and the partial word constraint requires the fill to end in "m" before the surviving "any," yielding "a great many."

The spiritual reading gives "arrangement" at this position; "ways" is the natural-plane equivalent completing "ordered in a great many ways," with the subsequent clauses specifying the ways of the Father of Life and the Mother of the Living.

fills.explanation: The editor's fill is confirmed: the Father of Life and the Mother of the Living are the standard Manichaean divine pair; the spiritual reading confirms this as Divine Wisdom paired with Divine Love as generative source, and the surviving text "the living" completes the title.

The spiritual reading gives "constitution is" at this position; "ordering" is the standard Kephalaia register term for the structural arrangement of the sphere, continuing the theme from ¶5 where the sphere "is ordered" with diligence.

The spiritual reading gives "arranged" at this position; "carefully arranged" completes the phrase "very carefully arranged with diligence," matching the chapter's repeated emphasis on the providential precision of the sphere's construction.

The spiritual reading gives "which are held dependent" — stronger than the editor's bare "who are"; the chapter's pervasive vocabulary of binding (¶2 "bound in them," ¶6 "bound and assigned," ¶7 "bound on it," ¶9 "bound on the sphere") confirms "who are bound" as the correct reading before "in it."

The spiritual reading shows a collective reference before "the goods"; "all the" is the standard Kephalaia quantifier used throughout the chapter for enumerating the king's gathered resources (cf. "all the leaders," "all the armour").

The spiritual reading lists "the goods" at this position alongside property; "property and goods" is a standard ancient pairing for material wealth distributed among a king's retinue, paralleling the chapter's enumeration of the ruling principle's resources.

The spiritual reading gives "natural affections" at this position; "cattle and flocks" is the standard ancient pairing for livestock (large and small), corresponding to the coarser and finer natural affections distributed among subordinate powers.
